name: a decision that changed is remembered at its new value, not its old one
description: LongMemEval's knowledge-update category, in the shape MEM-5 has to answer: a fact is stated, a later session states its replacement, and the probe must return the replacement alone. Before MEM-5 the store was ADD-only and both composed, which is a memory system telling an agent two contradictory things and letting it choose. The old decision is not deleted — it is closed in valid time, so `--as-of` still finds it (ADR-0039 decision 7) — and this scenario measures only what a live session sees.
